svg.aria-label: Dense PP film as a ring spacer: in the top view, the outer edge of the PP ring is no smaller than the spacer, the center hole is filled with electrolyte, and the hole diameter d sets the area A. In the cross section, two SS spacers press on the PP ring, and L equals the PP ring thickness.
